description: Spawns a controllable [[familiar]] that deals [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 cf-scope-alt|alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]] 37.5 / [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 cf-scope-alt|alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]] 15 damage per second on touch. It can be moved using the shooting directional keys
Repeatedly zaps enemies that are close to Isaac.
Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, he will respawn in the previous room with full health, after which 1up! will disappear.

Isaac fires two tears at once, one from each eye. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] 0.8× [[damage]] multiplier.

Enemies near Isaac are afflicted with [[fear]]. [[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[Category:Modified in Repentance+]] Grants +0.5 [[tears]] and +0.2 [[shot speed]].

[[File:Dlc na indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-1 |alt=(in Rebirth)|Removed in Afterbirth]][[Category:Modified in Afterbirth]] Gives Isaac a random tear effect every room.
[[File:Dlc a indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-30 |alt=(except in Rebirth)|Added in Afterbirth]][[Category:Modified in Afterbirth]] Gives Isaac a random tear effect every few seconds.
Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Instead, they're charged by dealing damage to enemies.
Spawns a random [[Harbinger]] [[familiar]] that changes every 10 seconds. Harbingers have different behaviors and spawn themed [[Locust]]s.
+1.5 [[damage]]. Replaces Isaac's tears with nails, which have increased [[knockback]].
Reduces the charge of any [[activated item]] by 1. Any 1 charge items instead have timed recharges.
+0.5 [[Tears]], +0.2 [[Shot Speed]].
Gives Isaac 100 [[File:Penny.png|link=Penny (Disambiguation)|alt=|Pennies]]‍[[:Penny (Disambiguation)|Pennies]].
The more distance tears travel, the more damage they will do.

Passively grants [[flight]] and increases [[speed]] to 1.5. Upon use, Isaac charges in the direction the pony is facing, giving [[invulnerability]] during the charge and dealing damage to enemies hit.

[[Devil Room|Devil deals]] now cost [[File:Penny.png|link=Penny (Disambiguation)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Coins]][[:Penny (Disambiguation)|Coins]], [[File:Shop Icon.png|link=Shop|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Shop|Shop]] items now cost [[health]], and [[consumable]]s in shops are free but surrounded by spikes.
Gives Isaac 25 [[File:Penny.png|link=Penny (Disambiguation)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|coin]][[:Penny (Disambiguation)|coin]]s.

Grants one full Red [[Heart container]]. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Heals 1 additional [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]].

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] +1.5 [[damage]], +0.2 [[speed]]. Removes all Red [[Heart container]]s, grants six [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]s, and adds a chance to shoot [[fear]] tears.
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] +1.5 [[damage]], +0.2 [[speed]]. Grants two [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]s, converts all Red [[Heart Container]]s into Black Hearts, and adds a chance to shoot [[fear]] tears.

[[File:Dlc na indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-1 |alt=(in Rebirth)|Removed in Afterbirth]][[Category:Modified in Afterbirth]] Spawns a [[familiar]] that mirrors Isaac's movements and shoots in the opposite direction.
[[File:Dlc a indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-30 |alt=(except in Rebirth)|Added in Afterbirth]][[Category:Modified in Afterbirth]] Spawns a [[familiar]] that mirrors Isaac's movements and shoots towards him.

Destroys all [[item]] pedestals in the room and gives Isaac a unique locust [[familiar]] for each item destroyed. Locusts fly forwards in the direction Isaac shoots and damage enemies hit. Destroying certain items spawns special locusts with unique effects.

Spawns a [[familiar]] that drops a random [[pill]] every [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]] 3 / [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]] 7 [[room]]s. Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room are [[poison]]ed.

+0.7 [[tears]], grants an [[File:Eternal Heart.png|link=Hearts#Eternal Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Eternal Heart]][[:Hearts#Eternal Heart|Eternal Heart]]. Allows [[File:Angel Room Icon.png|link=Angel Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Angel Room|Angel Room]]s to appear even if a Devil Deal has been taken before. Reduces the Devil/Angel room chance penalty for taking Red heart damage.
Increases [[damage]] based on how many empty [[Red Heart container]]s Isaac has.
While in an uncleared room, Isaac forms a trail of bloody tears that drags behind him, bursting and dealing damage upon contact with enemies.

Upon use, spawns three [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|alt=|Soul Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]]s and two [[File:Angel Room Icon.png|link=Angel Room|alt=|]]‍[[:Angel Room|Angel Room]] items and is consumed. Starts with no charges, and can only be charged by picking up 6 Soul Hearts.
Quadruples [[fire rate]], with ×0.3 [[damage]] multiplier. Each tear is given a random effect that alters its movement.
+0.35 [[tears]] up. Allows Isaac to fire tears diagonally.
Spawns six [[File:Troll Bomb.png|link=Bombs#Troll Bomb|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Troll Bomb]][[:Bombs#Troll Bomb|Troll Bomb]]s around the [[room]].

After Isaac is damaged, a trail of [[red creep]] will be left behind him until he leaves the current room. [[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] +5 [[range]]. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] +1.5 [[range]].
Spawns an [[orbital familiar]] with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.
Spawns a fly [[familiar]] that orbits around a random enemy and deals 30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.
Chains down the nearest enemy for 5 seconds, preventing them from moving or attacking.

Upon [[death]], Isaac will respawn as [[File:Character ??? icon.png|link=??? (Character)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|???]][[:??? (Character)|???]] in the previous room, with 3 [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Soul Heart]][[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]]s.

Tears float in position until firing ceases, after which they will fly off in the direction they were shot in. [[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] -2 Tear Delay. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] +1 Fire Rate.
+0.3 [[tears]]. Adds a chance to fire a razor blade that deals 4× Isaac's [[damage]].

A trail of [[blue creep]] is left behind Isaac, which damages enemies. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] The creep scales with [[damage]] and inherits most [[tear effect]]s.

+0.25 [[speed]]. Running into enemies while at a high speed will deal damage. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Prevents Isaac from taking contact damage while moving at high speed.
Causes Isaac to turn into a ghost if he gets hit while in an uncleared room, giving him [[flight]] and [[Tear Effects#Spectral|spectral tears]] and blocking the next hit he takes.

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] When Isaac takes damage, a damaging black ring briefly appears around him. This ring can cause enemies to drop [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]s.
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] After Isaac kills an enemy, adds a [[luck]]-based chance to spawn a damaging black ring around them.

Isaac builds rage every time a room is cleared. After four rooms, fires a large [[File:Collectible Brimstone icon.png|link=Brimstone|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Brimstone]][[:Brimstone|Brimstone]] laser when entering the next room.
Isaac's tears deal double [[damage]] and inflict [[Status Effects#Bleed|bleeding]] on enemies if they're facing away from Isaac.
Swipes a bag that collects and holds up to 8 [[pickup]]s, which can then be used to craft an item. The power level of the item is based on the quality of pickups used.
Creates an [[orbital familiar]]. Collecting additional copies gives it the ability to shoot [[Charm]] tears, then chase enemies to deal contact damage, then deal even more contact damage.
Adds a chance to shoot [[slow]]ing tears. Isaac leaves a trail of [[Creep#Black Creep|slowing]] [[creep]] behind as he moves, impeding enemies' speed.
Recharges Isaac's currently held active item and drops 2-4 batteries.
Spawns a [[familiar]] that flies around the room in a zig-zag pattern and explodes on contact with an enemy. Respawns after ten seconds.
Drops a random [[trinket]]. Grants a second trinket slot.
Causes enemies to bounce off of Isaac, dealing damage to them if they hit an enemy or obstacle. Also gives Isaac the chance to deflect enemy shots.

Isaac goes berserk for 5 seconds, greatly increasing his [[speed]], [[tears]], and [[damage]], but restricting him to using a melee weapon instead of his tears. This item charges by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms.

When hit, spawns a quickly [[orbital familiar|orbiting]] attack fly similar to [[File:Collectible Forever alone icon.png|link=Forever alone|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Forever alone]][[:Forever alone|Forever alone]] for the current [[room]] that deals high damage.
Spawns a decoy Isaac that explodes after 5 seconds. Enemies will always target the decoy and ignore Isaac.

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] [[Charm]]s all enemies in the room when Isaac takes damage.
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Enemies are able to damage each other. If an enemy is damaged by another enemy, they will attack that enemy instead of Isaac.
Increases the size and effectiveness of most [[familiar]]s.
Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac and charges across the [[room]] when Isaac fires, blocking shots and dealing 40.5 damage per second on contact.
Spawns a large, slow-moving [[orbital familiar]] that blocks enemy shots and deals 30 damage per second to enemies. Reduces the speed other orbitals rotate at.
+1 Red [[Heart Container]] and fully heals Isaac. Item pedestals also offer a random food item. Picking up a food item temporarily grants +3.6 [[damage]] and permanently boosts 2 [[stat]]s.
Grants one [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Soul Heart]][[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]], +0.75 [[tears]] and decreases Isaac's size.

The first time Isaac takes damage in a room, a [[familiar]] leaps on an enemy, dealing damage and releasing a rock wave. For the rest of the room, it chases enemies similar to [[File:Collectible Dead Bird icon.png|link=Dead Bird|Dead Bird|alt=]][[:Dead Bird|Dead Bird]].
Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.
Grants a [[character]]-specific effect that enhances their special abilities.

Prevents [[curse]]s. Grants one [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]. Increases the chance for a [[File:Devil Room Icon.png|link=Devil Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Devil Room|Devil Room]] or [[File:Angel Room Icon.png|link=Angel Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Angel Room|Angel Room]] to appear.
Throws a black hole on the ground which sucks in and damages enemies and destroys nearby obstacles.

Grants one Red [[Heart Container]], one [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Soul Heart]][[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]], and one [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]].

Isaac leaves a trail of black powder on the floor. Walking in a circle will spawn a pentagram symbol on the floor, which deals 10 damage per tick to any enemies inside it. [[Category:Modified in Repentance+]][[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]] Grants larger explosions and fireplaces will explode when extinguished.

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Copies the effect of the [[card]] or [[rune]] currently held by Isaac.
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Copies the effect of the [[card]] currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the card.

Grants one [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Soul Heart]][[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]]. Upon entering a boss room, grants a shield that blocks one hit, then disappears.

Grants one filled [[Red Heart container]], restores [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]] 4 / [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]] 5 [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|alt=|Red Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]]s, and increases [[speed]] by 0.3.

Grants a Red [[Heart container]] and restores 5 hearts. Bombs leave behind damaging [[red creep]]. Isaac can place [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|alt=|Bomb]]‍[[:Bombs|Bomb]]s at the cost of half a heart if he doesn't have any.

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]]Tears fired from the left eye have +1 flat [[damage]], +5 [[range]], and +0.5 [[tear falling speed]].
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]]Tears fired from the left eye have +1 flat [[damage]] and +2.75 [[range]].

Stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor, draining his [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]]s. Increases [[damage]] and [[speed]] for the floor based on the amount drained.
+1 [[damage]]. Isaac shoots blood tears.
Spawns a [[familiar]] that chases enemies. After killing enough enemies, it becomes more powerful but will also try to hurt Isaac. Dealing enough damage to it returns it to normal.

Takes a full heart of [[health]] and deals 40 damage to all enemies in the [[room]]. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Repeated uses in the same room only take half a heart. [[File:Dlc r+ indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-16 |alt=(in Repentance+)|Added in Repentance+]][[Category:Modified in Repentance+]] Increases [[fire rate]] when used.

[[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Spawns an [[orbital familiar]] that deals contact damage and fires a tear every 2 seconds.
[[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Spawns an [[orbital familiar]] that deals contact damage, blocks shots, and fires tears at enemies in its line of sight.
The first 6 times Isaac takes damage on a given floor, he gains [[Speed]] and [[Fire Rate]] for the rest of the floor, up to a maximum of +1.02 and +3.00, respectively.
Increases Isaac's [[damage]] whenever he takes damage, up to six times. The bonus resets when entering a new floor.

Gives one full Red [[Heart container]], +0.7 [[tears]], and -0.16 [[shot speed]]. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Heals 1 additional [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]].

Reveals the locations of [[File:Secret Room Icon.png|link=Secret Room||alt=]][[:Secret Room|Secret Room]]s and [[File:Super Secret Room Icon.png|link=Super Secret Room||alt=]][[:Secret Room#Super Secret Rooms|Super Secret Room]]s on the map.
Spawns a [[familiar]] that charges forward when shooting tears and explodes upon contact with an enemy, damaging and [[poison]]ing them. The familiar respawns after a few seconds.

+5 [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bomb]][[:Bombs|Bomb]]s. Grants Isaac's bombs a [[poison]] effect. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] They also leave a lingering poison cloud, and Isaac becomes immune to poison.
Isaac holds a [[poison]] [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|alt=|Bomb]]‍[[:Bombs|Bomb]] which can be thrown in a cardinal direction and explodes on impact.
+5 [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bomb]][[:Bombs|Bomb]]s. Bombs gain a [[Tear Effects#Homing|homing]] effect, slowly moving towards the nearest enemy.

All normal [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bomb]][[:Bombs|Bomb]]s become [[File:Double Bomb.png|link=Bombs#Double Bomb|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Double Bomb]][[:Bombs#Double Bomb|Double Bomb]]s.
Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac around and fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions.
Spawns a [[familiar]] that drops a [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|Bomb|alt=]][[:Bombs|Bomb]] every 3 rooms.

+5 [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|alt=|Bomb]]‍[[:Bombs|Bomb]]s. Isaac's bombs will now explode in a large cross-shaped pattern (roughly 5 bombs explosions wide). This also affects player-spawned [[File:Troll Bomb.png|link=Bombs#Troll Bomb|alt=|Troll Bomb]]‍[[:Bombs#Troll Bomb|Troll Bomb]]s.
Enemies spawn floating bones on death, which block shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.

Increases the chance of a [[File:Devil Room Icon.png|link=Devil Room|alt=|]]‍[[:Devil Room|Devil Room]] / [[File:Angel Room Icon.png|link=Angel Room|alt=|]]‍[[:Angel Room|Angel Room]] appearing while held. Upon use, gives one [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|alt=|Soul Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]], and replaces the boss of the current floor with a [[Harbinger]] if possible.

Gives the effect of [[File:Collectible Treasure Map icon.png|link=Treasure Map|alt=|Treasure Map]]‍[[:Treasure Map|Treasure Map]], [[File:Collectible The Compass icon.png|link=The Compass|alt=|The Compass]]‍[[:The Compass|The Compass]], or [[File:Collectible Blue Map icon.png|link=Blue Map|alt=|Blue Map]]‍[[:Blue Map|Blue Map]] for the duration of the current [[floor]]. [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]] If all effects are active, [[File:Collectible X-Ray Vision icon.png|link=X-Ray Vision|alt=|X-Ray Vision]]‍[[:X-Ray Vision|X-Ray Vision]] is provided for the floor instead. Highlights any [[Tinted Rock]]s and rocks with [[File:Crawl Space Icon.png|link=Crawl Space|alt=|]]‍[[:Crawl Space|Crawl Space]] in the room.
Creates a protective [[shield]], nullifying all types of damage in the current room for 10 seconds.

[[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]] Creates a [[friendly]] [[File:Bony.png|link=Bony|alt=|Bony]]‍[[:Bony|Bony]], [[File:Black Bony.png|link=Bony#Black Bony|alt=|Black Bony]]‍[[:Bony#Black Bony|Black Bony]], or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.
[[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]] Creates a [[friendly]] [[File:Bony.png|link=Bony|alt=|Bony]]‍[[:Bony|Bony]], [[File:Black Bony.png|link=Bony#Black Bony|alt=|Black Bony]]‍[[:Bony#Black Bony|Black Bony]], [[File:Bone Fly.png|link=Boom Fly#Bone Fly|alt=|Bone Fly]]‍[[:Boom Fly#Bone Fly|Bone Fly]], [[File:Revenant.png|link=Bony#Revenant|alt=|Revenant]]‍[[:Bony#Revenant|Revenant]], [[File:Big Bony.png|link=Fatty#Big Bony|alt=|Big Bony]]‍[[:Fatty#Big Bony|Big Bony]], or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.
Passively causes active items to spawn themed orbital wisp [[familiar]]s on use, which fire tears and block shots. Can be activated to spawn a basic wisp if Isaac has no other active item.
Grants 10 [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bomb]][[:Bombs|Bomb]]s.
Drops 5 random [[card]]s.
Spawns an orbiting fly [[familiar]] that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.

Spawns various [[pickup]]s: 1 [[File:Penny.png|link=Penny (Disambiguation)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|coin]][[:Penny (Disambiguation)|coin]], 1 [[File:Key.png|link=Keys|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Key]][[:Keys|Key]], 1 [[File:Bomb.png|link=Bombs|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bomb]][[:Bombs|Bomb]], 1 [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Heart]][[:Hearts#Red Heart|Heart]], 1 [[card]]/[[rune]], 1 [[pill]] and 1 [[trinket]].

Duplicates all of Isaac's [[familiar]]s for the current room. If Isaac has no familiars, spawns a [[File:Collectible Demon Baby icon.png|link=Demon Baby|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Demon Baby]][[:Demon Baby|Demon Baby]] for the room instead.

Spawns [[File:Dlc nr indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-7 |alt=(except in Repentance and Repentance+)|Removed in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]]1-4 / [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] 4-8 [[Blue Spider]]s where Isaac is standing.

+0.1 flat [[damage]], grants a [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|alt=|Soul Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]]. Enemies can randomly become briefly [[charm]]ed or [[fear]]ed. Taking damage has a chance to spawn a [[File:Rainbow Poop.png|link=Poops#Rainbow Poop|alt=|Rainbow Poop]]‍[[:Poops#Rainbow Poop|Rainbow Poop]].

Grants one full Red [[Heart container]]. [[Category:Modified in Repentance]][[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]] Heals 1 additional [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|alt=|Red Heart]]‍[[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]].
